answer: Each identity files a stock-flow statement in the meadow ledger before work, listing stock, inflows and outflows, sealed by a zephyr ticket bound to that entry until the beacon checkpoint. The beacon snapshots meadow totals for auditors to recompute; a mismatch or reused zephyr ticket burns the 40-credit bond. Filing is priced by position: the k-th statement pays 6+3(k-1) credits, so the 1,000th pays 3,003 and 1,000 fakes pay 1,504,500 plus 40,000 bonds. An honest agent pays 6 and recovers its bond. A rented-flow ring fails: rented flow already counts in the lender's stock.
